recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It addresses the clear current-source FHIR-16949 gaps without over-constraining broad canonical values; handle any future narrowing of the remaining broad/ambiguous bare canonical elements with specific Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-16949 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by FHIR-I. It requested that canonical declarations be qualified like Reference declarations, with bare canonical reserved for cases where all knowledge/structure resources are valid targets.
initial_application: SVN revision 13903, preserved as git commit 6c55fe476ebd, explicitly applied GF#16949 by changing JSON and SVG rendering so canonical target parameters render like Reference target parameters. Later same-family work, including FHIR-16765/FHIR-16769, qualified many knowledge-resource canonicals, but later source additions left a few clear profile/ruleset canonicals unqualified.
additional_context: DocumentReference, Endpoint, StructureDefinition, and ExampleScenario are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. A current audit found nine bare canonical type blocks before reconciliation; six are broad or generic value surfaces, while Endpoint.payload.profileCanonical, DocumentReference.content.profile.value[x], and ExampleScenario.instance.structureProfile[x] clearly describe FHIR profiles, content profiles, templates, rulesets, or profile canonicals whose FHIR canonical target is StructureDefinition. FHIR-39616 explicitly requested Endpoint.payload.profile as Canonical(StructureDefinition)|URI, and FHIR-37895 introduced ExampleScenario.structureProfile[x] for FHIR profiles as a uri|canonical choice.
reconciliation: Added targetProfile="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/StructureDefinition" to Endpoint.payload.profileCanonical, DocumentReference.content.profile.value[x], and ExampleScenario.instance.structureProfile[x]. Left RequestOrchestration.instantiatesCanonical, GuidanceResponse.module[x], ArtifactAssessment.artifact[x], Task input/output value[x], and Parameters.parameter.value[x] unqualified because their current definitions are broad or generic enough that narrowing them would require targeted work-group decisions.
source_changes: source/endpoint/structuredefinition-Endpoint.xml: added StructureDefinition targetProfile to Endpoint.payload.profileCanonical canonical type.
source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml: added StructureDefinition targetProfile to DocumentReference.content.profile.value[x] canonical type.
source/examplescenario/structuredefinition-ExampleScenario.xml: added StructureDefinition targetProfile to ExampleScenario.instance.structureProfile[x] canonical type.
